newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Frontier Insurance lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Frontier Insurance lowered.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said on Monday it lowered its intermediate-term rating on Frontier Insurance Group Inc to neutral from accumulate due to price appreciation, but kept its long-term buy rating on the shares.

-- "The stock has performed exceptionally well since we initiated coverage on it nine months ago," Jay Cohen, an analyst at Merrill Lynch, said. "While earnings have also climbed up nicely, the current stock price reflects near-term growth opportunities."
-- Cohen said he was not changing any of his earnings estimates on the company.
-- Frontier shares were trading off one point at 58-7/8.
